press_references.value: LUMICKS launches Avidion to improve cell therapy development

product_launches.description: LUMICKS announced the European launch of Avidion, a next‑generation Cell Avidity platform debuting at CICON 2025 in Utrecht; the automated, ML‑enhanced, 96‑well compatible instrument aims to speed cell therapy candidate screening and characterization.

overview_description.description: LUMICKS delivers state-of-the-art technologies for the study of biology and cancer at the single-molecule and single-cell levels. It aims to build the unfinished bridge between structure and function at the molecular and cellular levels. Using its product C-Trap Optical Tweezers, Fluorescence Microscopy, scientists are able to analyze complex biological processes in real-time. Similarly, the z-Movi Cell Avidity Analyzer enables the measurement and selection of immune cells based on their real-time interactions with target cells.

about_short_description.short_description: LUMICKS provides single-molecule analysis technologies for cancer research and immunotherapy.

product.name: C-Trap®
product.description: A dynamic single-molecule microscope that combines optical tweezers, fluorescence and label-free microscopy to manipulate, visualize and measure biomolecular interactions in real time.

product.name: Avidion
product.description: A high-throughput Cell Avidity platform for measuring the strength of interactions between cells or between cells and proteins in immunotherapy research.

product.name: z-Movi® Cell Avidity Analyzer
product.description: An instrument for small-scale Cell Avidity studies that measures cell–cell or cell–protein interaction strength using acoustic force and fluorescence imaging.

product.name: Avidigo Services
product.description: A contract research service that provides Cell Avidity experimental design, measurements, data analysis and interpretation for academic and industry customers.

product.name: Consumables & Reagents
product.description: Research consumables and reagents that support LUMICKS Dynamic Single-Molecule experiments and instrument workflows.

product.name: Application and Technical Support Services
product.description: Scientific application support, technical assistance, demonstrations, workshops, grant support and user education for LUMICKS technologies.
